name: Březina (Svitavy District, Czechia)
description: Two horizontal stripes of green and white in the ratio 3:1, with a yellow quarter-disc in the upper fly corner and four birch leaves one above the other at the hoist, white on the green and green on the white.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 14 March 2002 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
